text: つかまえたい　ポケモンの　じょうたいや　タイプをみて　どの　ボールが　つかまえ　やすいか　かんがえて　なげてみようね！

structure.jp: つかまえたい　ポケモンの　じょうたいや　タイプをみて
structure.en: look at the status and type of the Pokémon you want to catch

structure.jp: どの　ボールが　つかまえ　やすいか　かんがえて
structure.en: think about which Ball makes it easy to catch

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: みる after a て-form verb means 'try doing it and see'; the よう ending makes it 'let's'. なげてみよう = 'let's try throwing it'.

patterns.name: 〜か (question inside a sentence)
patterns.span: どの　ボールが　つかまえ　やすいか
patterns.explanation: A question ending in か can sit inside a bigger sentence as the thing you think about or know. どの　ボールが　つかまえ　やすいか　かんがえて = 'think about which Ball is easy to catch with'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb means 'want to do'; here it sits before ポケモン and describes it. つかまえたい　ポケモン = 'the Pokémon you want to catch'.
